title_ar: الشغلانة الحقيقية وخريطة الرحلة وعقد الداتا
title_en: The real job, the journey map and the data contract (alternate take of part 0)
how_to_read: sentences[].w = first..last word id inside this chapter; word k (0-based) of the sentence is first+k and `ar` is the spoken text (its space-separated tokens are those words); fr = [start_frame, end_frame] at 24 fps from the word map; impact = hook words (id=text); num = spoken numbers with data-contract fact ids; first_mention = glossary terms to chip (id=term); dup = same claim in another chapter. Anchor with {word, lead_frames} only. Visual candidates are ideas, never footage.

constraints.anchors: {word, lead_frames} only; never seconds or frames; event frame = word start - lead_frames
constraints.lead_frames: kinetic word -3, graphic state change -2, shot cut -4..-6 (inside a pause >= 200 ms), counter starts at the number word
constraints.density: >= 20 events/min; no gap > 4 s without an event (hold <= 6 s with reason); shot median 6-12 s, max 25 s (shots > 12 s: an event every 3 s)
constraints.coverage: every sentence >= 1 anchored event; >= 80 % of sentences a mechanism event; every spoken number and every first-mention term on screen
constraints.kinetic: 8-20 kinetic words per minute; <= 6 words and <= 2 lines on screen; impact word 1-2 words
constraints.fx: hero (real-time 3D) <= 5 % of chapter frames (ADR-002 RT5); fx_tier lite|standard|hero
constraints.text: text on busy backgrounds needs a plate or halo; sizes and safe areas: 04 sections 3.2 and 3.4
banned: invented numbers (every number: data-contract id or source sentence)
constraints.components: use only frozen components (harness/schemas/components/); requests go to corpus/specs/_component_requests.jsonl
constraints.chapter_rhythm: problem -> mental model -> progressive visual -> worked example -> prediction -> failure (crit) -> fix (ok) -> callback -> artifact (per chapter, not per sentence)

storyboard_notes.text: Front-loaded orientation stack (DD-P00-1, DD-P00-2 before CH-03; about 8 min shorter without DD-P01): give it a visual roadmap spine, an A-01 zoom-out and progress cues so it reads as an overview, not a delay. Director and educator lenses review it.

sentences.ar: يا أهلا بيكم، الشرح بتاعنا المرة دي مختلف شوية
sentences.en: Welcome, our explanation this time is a bit different.

sentences.ar: إحنا النهاردة بنحط حجر الأساس الخريطة الحقيقية اللي هنمشي عليها طول رحلتنا في DA Camp اللي متقسمة لـ 25 جزء
sentences.en: Today we lay the foundation: the real map we will follow throughout our DA Camp journey, which is split into 25 parts.

sentences.ar: دي مش مجرد مقدمة ده الـblueprint أو المخطط واللغة اللي هنفهم بيها كل حاجة جاية
sentences.en: This is not just an intro; it is the blueprint and the language we will use to understand everything that follows.

sentences.ar: جاهزين؟ يلا بينا نبدأ
sentences.en: Ready? Let's begin.

sentences.ar: الأجندة بتاعتنا سريعة ومباشرة هنتكلم عن طبيعة الشغلانة الحقيقية وبعدين خريطة الرحلة والـdata contract بتاعنا
sentences.en: Our agenda is quick and direct: the real nature of the job, then the journey map and our data contract.

sentences.ar: وندخل بعدها على لغتنا البصرية في الأنظمة وأخيراً قواعد المحاكاة وقالب التفكير
sentences.en: Then our visual language for systems, and finally the simulation rules and the thinking template.

sentences.ar: أربع نقاط هما الأساس قبل ما نكتب أي سطر كود
sentences.en: Four points that are the foundation before we write any line of code.

sentences.ar: ندخل فوراً في أول نقطة طبيعة الشغلانة الحقيقية بعيداً بقى عن الكلام النظري
sentences.en: Straight into the first point: the real nature of the job, away from theory.

sentences.ar: الخطوة اللي في النص بقى اللي هي make them reliable دي اللي بتاخد أكتر وقت ومجهود ومحدش بيتكلم عنها كتير
sentences.en: The middle step, make them reliable, takes the most time and effort, and nobody talks about it much.

sentences.ar: الوقت اللي بنقضيه عشان ننظف الداتا دي ونستخدم حاجة زي دالة Trim عشان ندمجهم كلهم في مكان واحد وتبقى داتا موثوقة
sentences.en: The time we spend cleaning this data, using something like the Trim function to merge them all into one and make it trustworthy,

sentences.ar: عشان كده خلينا نبص على الجدول ده من NilePay دي خدمة mobile money مصرية خيالية هنكمل بيها لحد آخر الرحلة
sentences.en: That is why we look at this table from NilePay, a fictional Egyptian mobile-money service we will follow to the end of the journey.

sentences.ar: قدامنا هنا ستة عمليات دفع من T1 لحد T6
sentences.en: Here we have six payments, from T1 to T6.

sentences.ar: لو ركزنا هنلاقي إن أربعة منهم ناجحين ومتعلمين بالأخضر OK واتنين فشلوا ومكتوب عليهم FAILED
sentences.en: Look closely: four succeeded and are marked green OK, and two failed and are labelled FAILED.

sentences.ar: طيب أربعة من الستة نجحوا تفتكروا نسبة النجاح كم؟ احسبوها إنتو
sentences.en: So four out of six succeeded. What do you think the success rate is? Work it out yourselves.

sentences.ar: بالظبط 66.67 من 100 % والمبلغ الإجمالي الناجح هو 400 جنيه
sentences.en: Exactly: 66.67 out of 100%, and the total successful amount is 400 pounds.

sentences.ar: متقسمين 250 من Operator A و150 من Operator B
sentences.en: Split as 250 from Operator A and 150 from Operator B.

sentences.ar: الأرقام دي مش عشوائية خليها في دماغكو كويس جدا
sentences.en: These numbers are not random; keep them well in mind.

sentences.ar: طيب خلينا ننقل على الجزء التاني خريطة الرحلة والـdata contract
sentences.en: Now let's move to the second part: the journey map and the data contract.

sentences.ar: إيه هي متطلبات السيستم اللي هنبنيه وليه الشغلانة دي بالذات
sentences.en: What are the requirements of the system we will build, and why this job in particular?

sentences.ar: الدور اللي بنجهز له ده مش مجرد Data Analyst عادي ولا Data Engineer بس هو ميكس متكامل
sentences.en: The role we are preparing for is not just a regular Data Analyst or only a Data Engineer; it is a complete mix.

sentences.ar: زي ما احنا شايفين في الثلاث أعمدة احنا محتاجين SQL قوي نقدر نقرأ الـexecution plans ونعمل tuning في قواعد بيانات زي MySQL و PostgreSQL
sentences.en: As the three columns show, we need strong SQL, able to read execution plans and do tuning on databases like MySQL and PostgreSQL.

sentences.ar: ومحتاجين نكتب كود بـPython وJava عشان نعمل CRUD operations على داتا حقيقية بأمان
sentences.en: And we need to write code in Python and Java to do CRUD operations on real data safely.

sentences.ar: وطبعا فهم عملي للـBig Data والDAGs لحد ما نوصل للـLLMs والAI agents اللي بتشغل أدوات وتعمل شغل فعلي مش مجرد شات
sentences.en: And of course a practical grasp of Big Data and DAGs, up to LLMs and AI agents that run tools and do real work, not just chat.

sentences.ar: الرحلة دي مش مجرد لستة أدوات بنرصها ده سيستم كامل بيكبر قدام عينينا خطوة بخطوة
sentences.en: This journey is not just a list of tools lined up; it is a whole system growing before our eyes step by step.

sentences.ar: الرحلة دي هنمشيها على سبع مراحل
sentences.en: We will walk this journey in seven stages.

sentences.ar: كل ده هنطبقوا على مشروع واحد ماشي معنا اسمه ShopFlow
sentences.en: We will apply all of this to one project that runs with us, called ShopFlow.

sentences.ar: والفرق بينهم هو اللي بيعمل لنا مشكلة الداتا المتأخرة
sentences.en: The difference between them is what causes the late-data problem.

sentences.ar: كمان الـbatch ID هو المنقذ بتاعنا
sentences.en: Also, the batch ID is our saviour.

sentences.ar: هو وحدة الـidempotency اللي بتضمن إننا لو أفلنا وشغلنا أي pipeline تاني الداتا ما تتكررش وتبوظ
sentences.en: It is the idempotency unit that guarantees that if we stop and rerun any pipeline, the data does not duplicate and break.

sentences.ar: وده بقى معمار A-01 ده الهدف النهائي اللي هنوصله
sentences.en: And this is the A-01 architecture, the final goal we will reach.

sentences.ar: ecosystem كامل من أول الـMySQL لحد PostgreSQL Star Schemas والAI Agents وكل ده الماسترو بتاعه هو الـAirflow
sentences.en: A full ecosystem from MySQL to PostgreSQL star schemas and AI agents, all orchestrated by Airflow as the maestro.

sentences.ar: مش محتاجين نحفظ الرسمة المرعبة دي دلوقتي خالص
sentences.en: We do not need to memorise this scary diagram at all right now.

sentences.ar: الفكرة أن بعد كل جزء هنخلصه هنرجع للرسمة دي وننور الجزء اللي فهمناه
sentences.en: The idea is that after every part we finish, we come back to this diagram and light up the part we understood.

sentences.ar: الرسمة ثابتة بس فهمنا إحنا اللي بيكبر ويوضح
sentences.en: The diagram is fixed; it is our understanding that grows and becomes clearer.

sentences.ar: كل دي مربعات فاضية دلوقتي بس هتتملي واحدة واحدة مع كل خطوة بنعملها
sentences.en: All these are empty boxes now, but they will fill up one by one with every step we take.

sentences.ar: نيجي بقى للقسم الثالث لغتنا البصرية في الأنظمة
sentences.en: Now to the third section: our visual language for systems.

sentences.ar: إزاي هنشوف ونقرأ الأنظمة دي في الدروس اللي جاية؟
sentences.en: How will we see and read these systems in the coming lessons?

sentences.ar: عندنا أربع عناصر بصرية أساسية أول تلاتة هما
sentences.en: We have four core visual elements; the first three are:

sentences.ar: القاعدة الرابعة بقى ودي الأهم على الإطلاق منهج الـFailure-first
sentences.en: The fourth rule, the most important of all: the Failure-first approach.

sentences.ar: وكل عطل بنحله هيسيب ورانا write-up صغير وده بيبقى أقوى دليل في أي portfolio
sentences.en: Every failure we fix leaves behind a small write-up, and that is the strongest evidence in any portfolio.

sentences.ar: وأخيراً القسم الرابع قواعد المحاكاة وقالب التفكير
sentences.en: Finally, the fourth section: simulation rules and the thinking template.

sentences.ar: إزاي هنمشي في تعلم أي مفهوم جديد؟
sentences.en: How will we go about learning any new concept?

sentences.ar: أي مفهوم جديد هندرسه هيمشي على قالب من تسع خطوات
sentences.en: Every new concept we study will follow a nine-step template.

sentences.ar: بنبدأ بالمشكلة ونبني صورة ذهنية وبعدها visual بيتبني بالتدريج قدامنا
sentences.en: We start with the problem and build a mental model, then a visual is built gradually in front of us.

sentences.ar: الخطوة الرابعة بنشوف مثال صغير بأرقام حقيقية زي اللي في جدول NilePay
sentences.en: Step four: we see a small example with real numbers, like the ones in the NilePay table.

sentences.ar: والخمسة بتبقى توقعنا لما parameter يتغير
sentences.en: Step five is our prediction when a parameter changes.

sentences.ar: وهنا لازم نأكد على حاجة مفيش أي حركة أو أنيميشن مجرد زينة
sentences.en: And here we must stress one thing: no motion or animation is mere decoration.

sentences.ar: كل سهم بيتحرك بيمثل ديتا أو request حقيقي جوه السيستم
sentences.en: Every moving arrow represents real data or a real request inside the system.

sentences.ar: لو شلنا الأنيميشن ومخسرناش فيه يبقى ديكت حركة زيادة عشان كده كل حاجة ليها معنى
sentences.en: If we removed the animation and lost nothing, it was extra motion; that is why everything has a meaning.

sentences.ar: نكمل القالب الخطوة السادسة هي العطل اللي بيحصل والسبعة هي الإصلاح
sentences.en: Continuing the template: step six is the failure that happens, and seven is the fix.

sentences.ar: في الخطوة الثامنة بنعمل callback ونربط اللي تعلمناه باللي فات
sentences.en: In step eight we do a callback, linking what we learned to what came before.

sentences.ar: والخطوة التسعة والأخيرة بتكون الـoutput artifact الناتج العملي اللي بنطلع به
sentences.en: The ninth and final step is the output artifact, the practical result we come away with.

sentences.ar: وأي تحذير أو بلس بيظهر قدامنا بيكون له سبب حقيقي في حالة السيستم ولازم نفهمه
sentences.en: Any warning or signal that appears has a real cause in the system state, and we must understand it.

sentences.ar: وقبل ما نقفل الشرح ده عندنا اتفاق أمانة هنقوله مرة واحدة بس
sentences.en: Before we close, we have an honesty agreement that we will state only once.

sentences.ar: المحاكاة اللي هنشوفها هنا هي نماذج تعليمية بتوضح الـoutputs الحقيقية لكنها مش متوصلة بـdatabases حقيقية شغالة live
sentences.en: The simulations we see here are teaching models showing the real outputs, but they are not connected to real live databases.

sentences.ar: الأرقام محسوبة ومدروسة وهترجع تاني لما نحتاجها
sentences.en: The numbers are calculated and deliberate, and they will come back when we need them.

sentences.ar: والمطلوب منكم دايماً قبل ما الانيميشن يشتغل توقعوا بصوت عالي اتفاعلوا وجاوبوا
sentences.en: What we always ask of you: before the animation plays, predict out loud, engage and answer.

sentences.ar: إننا نغلط بوعي ونتوقع غلط ونفهم إحنا غلطنا ليه دي أسرع وأقوى طريقة للتعلم
sentences.en: Being wrong consciously, predicting wrong and understanding why we were wrong, is the fastest and strongest way to learn.

facts.rule: A number goes on screen with its fact id as `ref`/`data_refs`. `unmatched_numbers` are spoken but have no data-contract fact: their source is the sentence itself (a valid `s:` ref); never replace them with a different figure.

glossary.rule: Explain the term in Egyptian Arabic the first time it appears; then use the original term naturally, in Latin script, inside Arabic sentences.
glossary.register_ar: Natural Egyptian, clear, calm, professional. Use إحنا and خلّينا نشوف and ببساطة where they help. No heavy Modern Standard Arabic. No exaggerated slang. Numbers are spoken naturally in Egyptian but displayed as Western digits.
glossary.register_en: Plain, direct, unhurried. Short sentences. No hype, no "imagine that…", no rhetorical questions that are not real prediction prompts. Say the number, then pause for half a beat before the next sentence — the pause is where the viewer reads the screen.
glossary.never_translate_rule: Explain them in Egyptian Arabic the first time they appear, then use the original term naturally.

first_mention_gloss.gloss_ar: إن تكرار نفس الطلب ما يعملش أثر زيادة

glossary.on_screen: Western digits, Latin terms in LTR isolates, Egyptian Arabic copy (no MSA), no per-letter animation (04 section 3.4).

concepts.def_en: A documented agreement between data producer and consumers on schema, meaning and quality, so changes do not silently break downstream users.
concepts.def_ar: اتفاق مكتوب بين اللي بيطلّع الداتا واللي بيستهلكها على الـschema والمعنى والجودة، عشان أي تغيير ما يكسرش حاجة بصمت.
concepts.failure: Changing a column's meaning or type without notice, breaking consumers downstream.

concepts.def_en: Financial services over a mobile phone, such as wallets, transfers and cash in/out, run b…
concepts.failure: Treating balances as a simple column update; money movement needs atomic, auditable trans…

concepts.def_en: Structured Query Language: the standard declarative language for querying and changing da…
concepts.failure: Thinking SQL runs in written order; the engine plans execution in its own order.

concepts.def_en: A widely used open-source relational database that stores data in tables and is queried with SQL.
concepts.def_ar: الـMySQL relational database مفتوحة المصدر ومنتشرة جداً، بتخزّن الداتا في جداول وبتتسأل بـSQL.
concepts.failure: Assuming MySQL and PostgreSQL behave identically in SQL dialect and defaults.

concepts.def_en: An open-source relational database (SQL) system known for standards compliance, transactions, rich data types and extensions; often called Postgres.
concepts.def_ar: الـPostgreSQL (أو Postgres) database علائقية open-source بتدعم SQL والـtransactions وأنواع داتا غنية وextensions.
concepts.failure: Assuming it behaves exactly like MySQL; syntax, types and plans differ between them.

concepts.def_en: A readable, general-purpose programming language widely used for data analysis, automatio…
concepts.failure: Using plain loops over huge data instead of vectorized pandas or SQL operations.

concepts.def_en: A statically typed, object-oriented language that runs on the JVM; used for large backend systems, APIs and big-data tooling.
concepts.def_ar: لغة object-oriented بـstatic typing بتشتغل على الـJVM؛ بتتستخدم في الـbackend الكبير والـAPIs وأدوات الـbig data.
concepts.failure: Ignoring null handling, leading to NullPointerException at runtime.

concepts.def_en: Data too large or fast to store or process on a single machine, so it is split and processed across a cluster.
concepts.def_ar: الـbig data هي الداتا اللي ما تقدرش تتخزن أو تتعالج على جهاز واحد، فبتتقسّم وتتعالج على cluster.
concepts.failure: Calling any large file big data; if one machine can handle it, it is not.

concepts.def_en: A group of records processed together in one run, as opposed to streaming; a batch identifier makes reloads safe to repeat.
concepts.def_ar: مجموعة سجلات بتتعالج مع بعض في تشغيلة واحدة بدل الـstreaming؛ ورقم الـbatch بيخلّي إعادة التحميل آمنة.
concepts.failure: Rerunning a batch load without deleting that batch first, duplicating rows.

concepts.def_en: Running an operation or request again gives the same result as running it once, so a stopped and rerun pipeline never duplicates data.
concepts.def_ar: إن تكرار نفس التشغيل أو الطلب يدّي نفس النتيجة زي تشغيله مرة؛ فالـpipeline لو وقفت واتعادت ما بتكرّرش الداتا.
concepts.failure: Rerunning a plain INSERT load after failure and silently duplicating the data.

concepts.def_en: A chain of automated steps where each stage's output feeds the next, such as extract, transform and load for data.
concepts.def_ar: سلسلة خطوات أوتوماتيك مخرجات كل مرحلة فيها بتدخل على اللي بعدها، زي extract وtransform وload في الداتا.
concepts.failure: Not making steps idempotent, so a rerun duplicates or corrupts data.

concepts.def_en: Apache Airflow: a platform that schedules and monitors workflows defined as DAGs of tasks, with retries, a calendar and a UI.
concepts.def_ar: Apache Airflow: منصة بتجدول وتراقب الـworkflows المعرّفة كـDAGs من tasks، ومعاها retries وتقويم وواجهة UI.
concepts.failure: Passing big data between tasks via XCom instead of storing it externally and passing references.

concepts.def_en: A named input in a function's definition; the caller supplies a value, called the argument, when calling it.
concepts.def_ar: اسم input في تعريف الـfunction، والمستدعي بيبعتله قيمة اسمها argument وقت الاستدعاء.
concepts.failure: Typing values by hand inside the code instead of passing them as parameters.

components.does: One whole word (or a tatweel-joined compound like الـKafka) on screen; never split per letter.
Up to 6 kinetic words on at most 2 lines, each word arriving on its own spoken word anchor.
A technical term chip (Latin in an LTR isolate) with an optional Arabic gloss; 28 px floor if spoken.
A counter that rolls from the previous value to the target over the spoken number (preset count).
An arrow from a label to a target layer (or a named part of it, 'layer.part').
Failure beat: glitch + low thud; flashes stay <= 3/s (WCAG 2.3.1).
Fix beat: the target settles into place with a settle chime.
The shot camera: move + ease + intensity; drift always on; optional impact nudges (<= 4 px) on anchors.
Match cut between a layer of this shot and one of the next.
Lower-third caption for a source, term, speaker or location.
Draw an SVG path (stroke reveal; RTL by default for Arabic layouts).
A request travelling hops (client, lb, service, cache, db, queue, external) with per-hop latency.
A data table (<= 8 columns, <= 12 visible rows); numbers come from a data_ref.
Deep-Dive entry card with parent chapter and prerequisite concepts.
